question: 'I2U2' initiative is also referred as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Asian Quad**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **West Asian Quad**:

 
 
• **The 'I2U2' **initiative is also referred to as the** West Asian Quad.**
 
• **The term "Quad" refers to a strategic grouping of countries.**
 
• In this context, the **West Asian Quad consists of four countries: India, UAE, Israel, and the United States. The initiative aims to enhance cooperation and promote security and stability in the West Asian region.**
 
 
 
• **West European Quad: **
 
 
• There is no known **"West European Quad" **in the context of international initiatives or strategic groupings. It is not a commonly used term in geopolitical discussions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term** "Quad" **refers to a strategic grouping of four countries.
 
• The Quad, also known as the **Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, is an informal strategic forum that includes four countries: the United States, Japan, Australia, and India.**
 
• The purpose of the Quad is to enhance cooperation and coordination on various regional and global issues, with a focus on promoting a free, **open, inclusive, and rules-based Indo-Pacific region.**
